2. Rub a thin coat of appliance polish or kitchen wax on the gaskets after cleaning.

solution_steps.issue: Trouble connecting the appliance to a Wi-Fi network if the wireless network name (SSID) is set incorrectly.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Verify that the wireless network name (SSID) is set correctly. The wireless network name (SSID) should be a combination of English letters and numbers. Do not use special characters.

2. If the security protocol of the router is set to WEP, change the security protocol to WPA2, which is recommended, and connect the product again.

3. Ensure that the router frequency is set to 2.4 GHz. Only a 2.4 GHz router frequency is supported. To check the router frequency, contact your Internet service provider or refer to your wireless router manual.

4. If the firewall on your wireless router is enabled, disable the firewall or add an exception to it.

5. If the appliance is too far from the router, the signal may be weak and the connection may not be configured correctly. Move the router closer to the appliance or purchase and install a Wi-Fi repeater.

6. If the network connection may not work properly depending on the Internet service provider, check with them for any issues.

7. If the appliance cannot be connected due to problems with the wireless signal transmission, unplug the appliance and wait about a minute before trying again.

solution_steps.issue: Wi-Fi connection issues if the router frequency is not 2.4 GHz.
solution_steps.steps:
1. The appliance supports 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi networks only. To check your network frequency, contact your Internet service provider or refer to your wireless router manual.

2. Only a 2.4 GHz router frequency is supported. Set the wireless router to 2.4 GHz and connect the appliance to the wireless router.

3. If the appliance cannot be connected due to problems with the wireless signal transmission, unplug the appliance and wait about a minute before trying again.

solution_steps.issue: Refrigerator is not leveled properly, affecting door alignment and operation.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Turn the leveling leg to the left to raise that side of the refrigerator or to the right to lower it. It may take several turns of the leveling leg to adjust the tilt of the refrigerator. A flare nut wrench works best, but an open-end wrench will suffice. Do not over-tighten.

2. Open both doors and check to make sure that they close easily. If the doors do not close easily, tilt the refrigerator slightly more to the rear by turning both leveling legs to the left. It may take several more turns, and be sure to turn both leveling legs the same amount.

3. Both the left and right refrigerator doors have an adjustable nut, located on the bottom hinge, to raise and lower them to align properly. If the space between the doors is uneven, use the wrench (included with the owner's manual) to turn the nut in the door hinge to adjust the height.

4. Open the door and use the wrench to loosen the keeper nut by turning it to the left.

solution_steps.issue: The appliance and the router are too far apart, leading to a weak Wi-Fi signal and connection problems.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "If the appliance is too far from the router, the signal may be weak and the connection may not be configured correctly. Move the router closer to the appliance or purchase and install a Wi-Fi repeater."

2. "If the appliance is having trouble connecting to the Wi-Fi network, it may be too far from the router. Purchase a Wi-Fi repeater (range extender) to improve the Wi-Fi signal strength."

solution_steps.issue: During Wi-Fi setup, the app requests a password to connect to the product, causing confusion.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Locate the network name which starts with "LG" under Settings > Networks. Note the last part of the network name.
2. If the network name looks like LGE_Appliance_XX-XX-XX, enter lge12345 as the password.
3. If the network name looks like LGE_Appliance_XXXX, enter XXXX twice as your password. For example, if the network name appears as LGE_Appliance_8b92, then you would enter 8b928b92 as your password. In this instance, the password is case sensitive and the last 4 characters are unique to your appliance.

solution_steps.issue: Audible diagnosis is interrupted if the phone is not correctly placed near the refrigerator's speaker.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Launch the LG ThinQ application and select the Smart Diagnosis feature in the menu. Follow the instructions for audible diagnosis provided in the LG ThinQ application.
2. Open the right refrigerator door.
3. Hold the Lock button for three seconds. If the display has been locked for over five minutes, you must deactivate the lock and then reactivate it.
4. Hold the mouthpiece of your phone in front of the speaker that is located on the right hinge of the refrigerator door.
5. Press and hold the Freezer button for three seconds while continuing to hold your phone to the speaker.
6. After you hear three beeps, release the Freezer button.
7. Keep the phone in place until the tone transmission has finished. The display will count down the time. Once the countdown is over and the tones have stopped, the diagnosis will be displayed in the application.
8. For best results, do not move the phone while the tones are being transmitted.

solution_steps.issue: Doors are often opened or left open for long periods, impacting the refrigerator's ability to maintain the set temperature.
solution_steps.steps:
1. To lessen the effect of moisture buildup, reduce the frequency and duration of door openings. 
2. When the doors are opened often or for long periods of time, warm, humid air enters the compartment. This raises the temperature and moisture level within the compartment.
3. Adding food and opening the door warms the refrigerator, requiring the compressor to run longer in order to cool the refrigerator back down. 
4. In order to conserve energy, try to get everything you need out of the refrigerator at once, keep food organized so it is easy to find, and close the door as soon as the food is removed. (Refer to the Food Storage Guide.)
5. Firmly push the doors shut. If they will not shut all the way, see the "Doors will not close correctly or pop open" section in Troubleshooting.

solution_steps.issue: Wi-Fi connection issues if the password for the Wi-Fi network is entered incorrectly.
solution_steps.steps: 1. "Delete your home Wi-Fi network and begin the connection process again."

solution_steps.issue: The wireless network name (SSID) is set incorrectly, preventing the appliance from connecting to the network.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that "The wireless network name (SSID) should be a combination of English letters and numbers. (Do not use special characters.)" as stated in the manual.
2. If the SSID contains special characters, change it to only include English letters and numbers.
3. Restart the connection process after adjusting the SSID to ensure the appliance can connect to the network properly.

solution_steps.issue: The router frequency is not set to 2.4 GHz, which is required for the appliance to connect to the wireless network.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Only a 2.4 GHz router frequency is supported. Set the wireless router to 2.4 GHz and connect the appliance to the wireless router." 

2. "To check the router frequency, check with your Internet service provider or the router manufacturer."

solution_steps.issue: The appliance and the router are too far apart, leading to a weak signal and connectivity problems.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "If the appliance is too far from the router, the signal may be weak and the connection may not be configured correctly."

2. "Move the router closer to the appliance or purchase and install a Wi-Fi repeater."

3. "Purchase a Wi-Fi repeater (range extender) to improve the Wi-Fi signal strength."

solution_steps.issue: Mobile data on the smartphone is turned on, interfering with the connection process between the appliance and the network.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Turn off the Mobile data on your smartphone before connecting the appliance.

solution_steps.issue: Changes in the wireless router, Internet service provider, or password requiring the appliance to be reconnected to the LG ThinQ application.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Delete the connected appliance from the LG ThinQ application.
2. Connect it again by following these steps:
   - For models with QR Code: Scan the QR code attached to the product using the camera or a QR code reader application on your smartphone.
   - For models without QR Code: Search for and install the LG ThinQ application from the Google Play Store or Apple App Store on a smartphone.
3. Run the LG ThinQ application and sign in with your existing account or create an LG account to sign in.
4. Touch the add (~) button on the LG ThinQ application to connect your LG appliance. Follow the instructions in the application to complete the process.
5. To verify the Wi-Fi connection, check that the Wi-Fi indicator on the control panel is lit.
6. If the security protocol of the router is set to WEP, network setup may fail. Change the security protocol (WPA2 is recommended), and connect the product again.

solution_steps.issue: Audible diagnosis not functioning correctly if the display lock on the refrigerator has been activated for over five minutes.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Open the right refrigerator door.
2. Hold the Lock button for three seconds.
   - If the display has been locked for over five minutes, you must deactivate the lock and then reactivate it.
3. Hold the mouthpiece of your phone in front of the speaker that is located on the right hinge of the refrigerator door.
4. Press and hold the Freezer button for three seconds while continuing to hold your phone to the speaker.
5. After you hear three beeps, release the Freezer button.
6. Keep the phone in place until the tone transmission has finished. The display will count down the time. Once the countdown is over and the tones have stopped, the diagnosis will be displayed in the application.

issues: The fridge doors do not open wide enough due to an uneven refrigerator level.
The SmartThings app fails to operate specifically with Samsung Smart Home models.
The SmartThings app is installed but not connected because the Wi-Fi icon on the refrigerator's display is off.

solution_steps.issue: The fridge doors do not open wide enough due to an uneven refrigerator level.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Determine which part of the refrigerator is low: "The rear sides of the refrigerator are low" or "The rear-left side of the refrigerator is low" or "The rear-right side of the refrigerator is low."

2. For both doors not opening wide enough, "Raise the rear sides of the refrigerator to level it."

3. For the left door not opening wide enough, "Raise the rear-right side of the refrigerator to level it."

4. For the right door not opening wide enough, "Raise the rear-left side of the refrigerator to level it."

5. Refer to the “STEP 4 Leveling the refrigerator” section on page 43 for detailed instructions on leveling the refrigerator.

solution_steps.issue: The SmartThings app fails to operate specifically with Samsung Smart Home models.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that the SmartThings app is available for applicable models only.
2. Verify that you are not attempting to connect using the old Samsung Smart Refrigerator app, as it cannot connect with Samsung Smart Home models.
3. You must log into your Samsung account to use the app.
4. Make sure that your router is operating normally.
5. If the Wi-Fi icon on the refrigerator’s display is off, this indicates that no network connection has been established. Use the SmartThings app to connect and register your refrigerator to the access point (AP) of your house.
6. If the SmartThings app is successfully connected to your refrigerator but does not run, exit and restart the SmartThings app, or disconnect and reconnect the router.
7. Power off the refrigerator, and then power it on again after 1 minute.

solution_steps.issue: The SmartThings app is installed but not connected because the Wi-Fi icon on the refrigerator's display is off.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Make sure that your router is operating normally.
2. Use the SmartThings app to connect and register your refrigerator to the access point (AP) of your house.
3. Log into your Samsung account to use the app. If you don’t have a Samsung account, follow the app’s onscreen instructions to create one.
4. If the SmartThings app is successfully connected to your refrigerator but does not run, exit and restart the SmartThings app, or disconnect and reconnect the router.
5. Power off the refrigerator, and then power it on again after 1 minute.
6. Turn on the Wi-Fi Connect on the refrigerator to control and monitor your refrigerator on the SmartThings app.

solution_steps.issue: Water flow is weaker than normal due to low water pressure in the connected supply.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Make sure the water pressure is between 206-861 kPa.
2. If the water pressure is below these specifications, check if the sediment filter in the reverse osmosis system is blocked. Replace the filter if necessary.
3. Refill the water tank in the reverse osmosis system with water.
4. If your refrigerator has a water filter, it may further reduce the water pressure when used in conjunction with a reverse osmosis system. Remove the water filter.
5. For more information or servicing, contact a licensed plumbing professional.

solution_steps.issue: Ice maker makes a buzzing sound because the water supply to the refrigerator has not been connected.
solution_steps.steps: 1. "Turn off the Ice Maker."

solution_steps.issue: Ice does not dispense because the ice bucket is not properly inserted.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Check the position of the ice bucket before using each ice maker.
2. Place the ice bucket against the wall directly underneath the ice maker. If the ice bucket is not directly underneath the ice maker, the ice maker may not make ice.
3. Place the ice bucket under the ice maker with the side marked 'REAR' facing the back.
4. Place the scoop holder at the front of the ice bucket.
5. Make sure the ice bucket is properly inserted.

solution_steps.issue: Could not find the SmartThings app in the app market due to changes in OS supporting policy.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Visit the Google Play Store, Galaxy Apps, or Apple App Store and search for “SmartThings”.
2. Note: "The supporting software version of the SmartThings app is subject to change according to the OS supporting policy the manufacturer provides."
3. In addition: "As for the SmartThings app or the functions that the app supports, the new application update policy on the existing OS version can be suspended due to usability or security reasons."
4. If you have enquiries regarding the items mentioned above, contact us at st.service@samsung.com.

solution_steps.issue: Ice maker does not make ice immediately after installation; it requires 24 hours to start producing ice.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Ice maker has just been installed. You must wait for 24 hours for the refrigerator to make ice."
2. "Set the freezer temperature below -18 °C or -20 °C in warm ambient air."
3. "Turn on the ice maker."

solution_steps.issue: Freezer temperature is too high, affecting the ice-making process.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Set the freezer temperature below -18 °C or -20 °C in warm ambient air."
2. "Do not overload the refrigerator. Do not allow food to block vents."

solution_steps.issue: Ice may jam if the ice dispenser is not used for a long time, approximately 3 weeks.
solution_steps.steps:
1. If you won't be using the refrigerator for a long time, empty the ice bucket and turn off the ice maker.
2. Make sure the ice bucket is properly inserted.

solution_steps.issue: Automatic icemaker does not work when the icemaker switch is in the OFF position.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Slide the switch to the ON position.

solution_steps.issue: Water filter is not properly installed, causing a water leak.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Replace filter or make sure the water filter is properly installed (see water filter section)."
2. "Wipe off the filter/surrounding area if there is any water from filter replacement."
3. "Verify there are no scratches or filter label damage."
4. "Replace filter if filter label shows damage."

solution_steps.issue: Interior light does not work due to a burned-out bulb.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Interior light does not work. Possible cause: Light bulb burned out. Action: See Replacing the light bulbs.
2. For LED lights, call GE Appliances Service at 1.800.432.2737 in the United States or 1.800.561.3344 in Canada.

solution_steps.issue: Hot air is expelled from the bottom of the refrigerator, which might discolor sensitive floor coverings.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Refer to the manual: "Normal air flow cooling motor. In the refrigeration process, it is normal that heat be expelled in the area under the refrigerator."
2. If concerned about floor coverings: "Some floor coverings are sensitive and will discolor at these normal and safe temperatures."
3. Address sensitive floor coverings by considering alternative materials or protective measures to prevent discoloration from the normal heat expelled by the refrigerator.

solution_steps.issue: Refrigerator never shuts off but maintains correct temperatures due to adaptive defrost.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Ensure that the refrigerator door remains closed for 2 hours, as "the refrigerator will cycle off after the door remains closed for 2 hours."

solution_steps.issue: Cubes can become jammed in the chute, leading to water on the kitchen floor or bottom of the freezer.
solution_steps.steps: 1. "Poke ice through with a wooden spoon."

solution_steps.issue: Experience of fog or small amounts of moisture in the refrigerator compartment.
solution_steps.steps:
1. This is normal for the beverage center loads and environmental conditions change.
2. Wipe with a paper towel if desired.

solution_steps.issue: Ice cubes have an odor or taste, indicating the need to clean the ice storage bin.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Empty and wash the ice storage bin.
2. Discard old cubes.

solution_steps.issue: Interior light does not work because there is no power at the outlet.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Replace fuse or reset the breaker.
2. Have the wall outlet and circuit checked by a qualified electrician to make sure the outlet is properly grounded.
3. The refrigerator should always be plugged into its own individual electrical outlet which has a voltage rating that matches the rating plate.
4. Plug into a grounded 3-prong outlet.

solution_steps.issue: Food transmitting odors or tastes to ice cubes due to improper food wrapping.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Wrap foods well to prevent them from transmitting odor/taste to ice cubes.

issues: Water filter indicator light remains lit after replacing the filter.
Handle is loose or has a gap, requiring adjustment.

solution_steps.issue: Water filter indicator light remains lit after replacing the filter.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Press WATER FILTER pad for 3 seconds to reset the water filter.

solution_steps.issue: Handle is loose or has a gap, requiring adjustment.
solution_steps.steps:
1. If door handles are loose or have a gap, the handle can be adjusted using a 1/8” allen wrench.
2. Locate the set screws on the ends of the handles.
3. Use the 1/8” allen wrench to adjust the set screws on either end of the handles.

solution_steps.issue: Refrigerator beeps due to the door alarm.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure the refrigerator doors are closed properly, as "The alarm will sound if either door is left open for more than 2 minutes. The beeping stops when you close the door."
2. If you wish to disable the door alarm, "Turn off or disable with door closed."
3. If the door is open and the alarm is sounding, note that "you can only snooze the alarm."

solution_steps.issue: No water or ice cube production because the supply line or shutoff valve is clogged.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Call a plumber.

solution_steps.issue: Water is leaking from the dispenser due to air presence in the water line system.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Dispense water for at least 5 minutes to remove air from system.

solution_steps.issue: Freezer cooling while fresh food section is not cooling when the refrigerator is first plugged in.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Wait 24 hours for temperature in both compartments to reach selected temperatures.

solution_steps.issue: Not cooling due to the cooling system being off.
solution_steps.steps: 1. See About Controls.

solution_steps.issue: Water has poor taste or odor, potentially indicating a need for filter replacement.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Dispense water, until all water in system is replenished.
2. If water flow from the dispenser slows, or ice production decreases, replace the water filter, even though the filter indicator may not indicate the need for replacement.
3. Run cold water from the dispenser for 5 minutes (about 2 gallons) if a newly installed filter cartridge is present.

solution_steps.issue: Ice dispenser opens after closing the freezer drawer, considered a normal occurrence.
solution_steps.steps:
1. The ice dispenser door may open after closing the freezer door to allow access.
2. This is considered a normal occurrence and does not require any further action.

solution_steps.issue: Water filter indicator light is not lit, indicating a need to replace the filter soon.
solution_steps.steps: 1. "This is normal. This indicator will turn on to tell you that you need to replace the filter soon. See About the Water Filter for more information."

solution_steps.issue: The UV LED lamp causes eye strain when stared at for long periods.
solution_steps.steps: 1. "Never stare directly at the UV LED lamp for long periods of time."

solution_steps.issue: Unauthorized modifications may lead to safety problems and incur full cost charges for parts and labor.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Do not attempt to repair, disassemble, or modify the refrigerator yourself.
2. Unauthorized modifications can cause safety problems.
3. To reverse an unauthorized modification, we will charge the full cost of parts and labor.
4. If your refrigerator needs to be repaired or reinstalled, contact your nearest service center.

solution_steps.issue: Issues with reversing an unauthorized modification can lead to additional charges.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Do not attempt to repair, disassemble, or modify the refrigerator yourself."
2. "Unauthorized modifications can cause safety problems."
3. "To reverse an unauthorized modification, we will charge the full cost of parts and labor."
4. "If your refrigerator needs to be repaired or reinstalled, contact your nearest service center."
5. "Failing to do so may result in an electric shock, fire, problems with the product, or injury."

solution_steps.issue: The feature panel may not function correctly if protective plastic film is not removed before initial use.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Remove the PE foam sheet on each shelf corner, which is attached to protect the refrigerator during transportation.

solution_steps.issue: Grounding issues might cause severe electric shock if the refrigerator is not safely grounded.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Always make sure that you have grounded the refrigerator before attempting to investigate or repair any part of the appliance. Power leakages can cause severe electric shock.
2. Never use gas pipes, telephone lines, or other potential lightning attractors as an electrical ground.
3. You must ground the refrigerator to prevent any power leakages or electric shocks caused by current leakage from the refrigerator.

solution_steps.issue: Reinstallation not performed by a service center may result in electric shock or product problems.
solution_steps.steps:
1. If your refrigerator needs to be repaired or reinstalled, contact your nearest service center. Failing to do so may result in an electric shock, fire, problems with the product, or injury.
2. The appliance must be positioned so that the plug is accessible after installation. Failing to do so may result in an electric shock or fire due to electric leakage.
3. Any servicing must be performed by a qualified technician.
4. To prevent electric shock, unplug the power cord before servicing or replacements.

solution_steps.issue: Standing on the appliance or placing objects on it may result in electric shock or fire.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Do not stand on top of the appliance or place objects (such as laundry, lighted candles, lighted cigarettes, dishes, chemicals, metal objects, etc.) on the appliance.
2. Do not put a container filled with water on the appliance. If spilled, there is a risk of fire or electric shock.
3. Do not store articles on the top of the appliance. When you open or close the door, the articles may fall and cause personal injury and/or material damage.

solution_steps.issue: Using non-standard fuses could lead to safety issues such as electric shock or fire.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Do not use any fuse (such as cooper, steel wire, etc.) other than a standard fuse.
2. If the power cord is damaged, have it replaced immediately by the manufacturer or one of its service agents.
3. The fuse on the refrigerator must be changed by a qualified technician or service company.

solution_steps.issue: Placing a container filled with water on the appliance risks fire or electric shock if spilled.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Do not put a container filled with water on the appliance.
2. If spilled, there is a risk of fire or electric shock.

solution_steps.issue: Damage to the refrigerant circuit may cause operational problems or safety hazards.
solution_steps.steps:
1. When transporting and installing the appliance, care should be taken to ensure that no parts of the refrigerating circuit are damaged. 
2. If a leak is detected, avoid any naked flames or potential sources of ignition and air the room in which the appliance is standing for several minutes.
3. It is hazardous for anyone other than an Authorised Service Person to service this appliance.
4. Never start up an appliance showing any signs of damage. If in doubt, consult your dealer.
5. Contact your nearest service center if your refrigerator needs to be repaired or reinstalled. Failing to do so may result in an electric shock, fire, problems with the product, or injury.

solution_steps.issue: The AI Vision Inside feature doesn't recognize or manage the ingredients stored in the refrigerator.
solution_steps.steps: I'm sorry, but the manual provided does not contain specific troubleshooting steps for the AI Vision Inside feature not recognizing or managing ingredients in the refrigerator. I recommend consulting the refrigerator's online manual or contacting customer support for assistance.

solution_steps.issue: The AI Energy Mode icon does not appear even when the mode is supposed to be operating.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that your refrigerator model is compatible with AI Energy Mode. The manual states, "You may turn on or off the AI Energy Mode in the SmartThings app. (applicable models only)."

2. Verify that the SmartThings app is properly set up on your device, as it is required to control the AI Energy Mode. The manual mentions, "You can control and monitor your refrigerator on the SmartThings app. For more information, see the SmartThings (applicable models only) section."

3. Check if the AI Energy Mode has been activated through the SmartThings app. The manual notes, "The AI Energy Mode may not operate according to user settings or the operating environment."

4. Consider environmental factors that might affect the operation of AI Energy Mode, as the manual indicates, "The AI Energy Mode may not operate according to user settings or the operating environment."

5. If the issue persists, refer to additional support resources or contact customer service for further assistance, as the manual's information is limited to applicable models and settings.

solution_steps.issue: Power Cool function indicator fails to display when the function is active.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Open the right-side fridge door and locate the switch cover on the top right corner of the door.

2. Push up the cover to reveal the power switch.

3. Turn the switch off and turn it on again.

4. Reinsert the switch cover to the end until you hear a clicking sound.

solution_steps.issue: The SmartThings app fails to connect to the refrigerator for remote control.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that you have logged into your Samsung account, as it is necessary to use the app: "You must log into your Samsung account to use the app."

2. Verify that your router is operating normally: "Make sure that your router is operating normally."

3. Check that the Wi-Fi icon on the refrigerator's display is on. If it is off, it indicates that no network connection has been established yet: "If the Wi-Fi icon on the refrigerator’s display is off, this indicates that no network connection has been established yet."

4. Use the SmartThings app to connect and register your refrigerator to the access point (AP) of your house: "In this case, use the SmartThings app to connect and register your refrigerator to the access point (AP) of your house."

5. If the connection fails due to distance from your access point or electrical interference, wait a moment and try again: "Easy Connection may fail due to the distance from your access point (AP) or electrical interference from the surrounding environment. Wait a moment and try again."

6. Exit and restart the SmartThings app, or disconnect and reconnect the router if the app is successfully connected but does not run: "Exit and restart the SmartThings app, or disconnect and reconnect the router."

solution_steps.issue: The App dock handler does not appear on the Home screen as expected.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure you are on the Home screen, as the manual states: "The App dock handler only appears on the Home screen."
2. If you are not on the Home screen, tap the Home button to open the Home screen as per the manual's instruction: "Tap to open the Home screen."
3. If the issue persists, verify that the home screen is set up correctly and that no items are blocking the App dock handler by checking: "On the home screen, you can add or remove items such as apps, widgets, pictures, videos, drawings, and texts."
4. If necessary, enter Edit mode to rearrange or remove items: "Tap and hold an item to enter Edit mode. In Edit mode, you can drag and drop an item to a new location on the home screen. When you move the item to a new location, the item turns red if the location is not available."

solution_steps.issue: The Fridge Manager does not allow setting the desired temperature or modes for each compartment.
solution_steps.steps:
1. On the Home screen, tap the Fridge Manager app.
2. You can set the desired temperature or modes for each compartment. For more detailed information on the Fridge Manager app, check the online manual.
3. To access the online manual from your refrigerator, tap > General > Support > User manual.

solution_steps.issue: Abnormal sounds are heard from the refrigerator during operation.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Review the checkpoints in the manual to determine if the sounds you are hearing are considered normal. The manual states: "Any service calls related to normal sounds will be charged to the user."
2. Check if the sounds are similar to a car engine igniting when starting or ending an operation. The manual notes that "As the operation stabilizes, the sounds will decrease."
3. Listen for clicking, chirping, or buzzing sounds while the fan is operating. The manual mentions that "When the refrigerator reaches the set temperature, no fan sound will occur."
4. During a defrost cycle, pay attention to any sizzling sounds. The manual explains that "water may drip on the defrost heater, causing sizzling sounds."
5. Identify if bubbling sounds occur. According to the manual, "as the refrigerator cools or freezes, refrigerant gas moves through sealed pipes, causing bubbling sounds."
6. Notice any knocking noises as the refrigerator temperature changes. The manual indicates that "plastic parts contract and expand, creating knocking noises" during the defrosting cycle or when electronic parts are working.
7. For ice maker models, check for buzzing sounds when the water valve opens to fill the ice maker.
8. Be aware of whooshing sounds when opening and closing the refrigerator door. The manual states that "because of pressure equalizing," these sounds may occur.

solution_steps.issue: The Power Freeze function does not activate or indicate when in use.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that the freezer is not set to Off mode, as the Power Freeze function cannot be activated if the freezer is off. The manual states, "When the freezer is set to Off mode, the freezer temperature will be kept under 15 °C, but the fridge remains active as previously set."

2. Check the freezer indicator on the main panel to see if the Power Freeze function is indicated. The manual mentions, "• indicates that the Power Freeze function is on."

3. If the Power Freeze function is not indicated, verify that you have selected the correct compartment and confirmed your selection. The manual states, "Wait for 5 seconds to confirm your selection. - The selected compartment’s indicator stops blinking."

4. Remember that the appearance of the main panel may differ from the figure in the manual, as stated, "The actual appearance of your main panel may differ from the figure and the main panel design is subject to change without notice."

5. If the Power Freeze function remains unresponsive, consider checking the AI Energy Mode. The manual suggests, "The icon appears when the AI Energy Mode is operating. You may turn on or off the AI Energy Mode in the SmartThings app. (applicable models only)". This may affect the operation of the Power Freeze function.

6. If none of the above steps resolve the issue, verify if the increased power consumption from using Power Freeze is a factor. The manual notes, "Using Power Cool or Power Freeze increases power consumption." Ensure your appliance is properly powered and not experiencing any power issues.

solution_steps.issue: The freezer does not maintain the set temperature accurately.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Properly plug in the power cord.
2. Set the temperature lower.
3. Keep the refrigerator away from direct sunlight or a heat source.
4. We recommend that the gap between the refrigerator and nearby walls (or cabinets) is more than 50 mm.
5. Ensure that food is not blocking the refrigerator.
6. Activate Power Freeze for at least 20 hours before putting food in the freezer to freeze large amounts of food.

solution_steps.issue: The App tray button does not respond when tapped to view all available apps.
solution_steps.steps: I don't know.

issues: The ice maker fails to indicate the correct status with the Ice Maker On/Off indicators.

AutoFill pitcher does not fill automatically on applicable models.
The Quick Space shelf does not adjust or lock into place properly.
Beverage Center door does not close securely on dispenser models.

solution_steps.issue: The ice maker fails to indicate the correct status with the Ice Maker On/Off indicators.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Tap any button to wake up the display. This step may not apply to some models.

2. Tap until the Ice Maker indicator blinks.

3. Tap to turn on or off the ice maker. - Tap to turn it on. - Tap to turn it off.

4. Wait for 5 seconds or tap to confirm your selection. - The Ice Maker indicator stops blinking.

5. If the ice maker does not dispense ice, first check the status of the ice maker using the Test button on the bottom of the ice maker.

6. Press the Test button on the bottom of the ice maker. You will hear a chime (ding-dong) when you press the button. You will hear another chime if the ice maker is operating properly.

solution_steps.issue: The Water Filter indicator does not reset after replacing the filter.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Tap any button ( , , or ) to wake up the display.
2. Tap until the Water Filter indicator blinks.
3. Tap or to select Reset.
4. Wait for 5 seconds or tap to confirm your selection.
5. The Water Filter indicator stops blinking.

solution_steps.issue: The Peak Demand indicator does not display the correct status of the Peak Demand function.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Tap and hold for 3 seconds to activate or deactivate Peak Demand Off (Override mode). 
2. Then the Peak Demand Off (Override mode) icon ( ) turns on or off accordingly to indicate the current status.
3. If the refrigerator receives a SMART GRID (Demand Response) signal from the utility company, 'Or' is displayed in the freezer temperature display.
4. Alternatively, you can activate or deactivate Peak Demand Off (Override mode) using the SmartThings app and the Energy Management function.
5. Ensure the corresponding app is installed to use the Energy Management refrigerator functions.

solution_steps.issue: Ice crushing function does not crush ice effectively, resulting in large chunks remaining.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Use the PULSE button to begin the blending process when preparing beverages that include ice cubes; this helps to produce a smoother texture.
2. When using PULSE function use short bursts. Allow the blades to stop rotating between pulses. Do not use pulse for more than 2 minutes.
3. It is helpful to begin the blending process on the lowest speed and then increase to a higher speed, if necessary.
4. Make sure to scrape down sides on blending jar, if necessary, and continue blending.
5. Do not run blender for longer than 30 seconds when using dry foods and 2 minutes when blending liquids.

4. If liquids spill onto base, wipe with damp cloth and dry thoroughly.

solution_steps.issue: A burning smell emanates from the unit, potentially indicating a manufacturing residue or overheating.
solution_steps.steps:

solution_steps.steps: 1. Always remove lid before removing bowl to avoid possible damage to the appliance.

solution_steps.issue: Food is not sliced or shredded uniformly, possibly due to packing too much food or pushing too hard.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Refer to the Food Processing Charts for recommended sizes and quantities to avoid packing too much food in the food chute.
2. Avoid pushing too hard on the food pusher to prevent irregular slicing or shredding.
3. "Always use food pusher to feed food into the chute. NEVER PUSH FOOD THROUGH CHUTE WITH HANDS OR OTHER OBJECTS."
4. Ensure that "the bowl and lid [are] locked in place," as they may have moved slightly during processing. See “How to Use” sections for detailed instructions.

solution_steps.issue: Cheese does not shred well, which may be related to incorrect processing techniques or settings.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that the cheese is processed immediately after being removed from the refrigerator. According to the manual, "Cheese should be processed immediately after being removed from the refrigerator."

2. If you are shredding soft cheese like mozzarella, place it in the freezer for 30 minutes prior to processing. The manual states, "Soft cheese like mozzarella must be placed in the freezer for 30 minutes prior to processing to ensure it is firm enough for shredding."

3. Verify that you are using the reversible slicing/shredding disc correctly. The manual instructs, "The reversible slicing/shredding disc has a slicing blade on one side and shredding teeth on the other. The name stamped on the blade, facing up, is the function selected. Place on motor shaft with desired cutting edge facing up."

4. Make sure you are using the recommended food size and quantity to be processed. The manual advises to "Refer to the Food Processing Charts for recommended food sizes and speeds."

5. Check if the bowl and lid are locked in place as they "may have moved slightly during processing." See “How to Use” sections for further guidance.

solution_steps.issue: The outlet may not work, affecting the appliance's operation.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Check if the outlet is still working by plugging in a working lamp or other appliance. 
2. If the outlet does not work with another appliance, you may have overloaded the circuit and blown a fuse or tripped the circuit breaker.
3. If none of these suggestions correct the problem, DO NOT attempt to repair the unit. Call the Customer Service number to get the name of your nearest Authorized Service Center.

solution_steps.issue: The bowl and lid are not locked in place, preventing the appliance from operating properly.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Align bowl and base. Turn bowl clockwise to lock into place. NOTE: Unit will not work unless bowl is locked.

2. Align lid and bowl. Turn lid clockwise to lock into place. NOTE: Unit will not work unless lid is locked.

solution_steps.issue: Electrical shock risk if the base, motor, cord, or plug is immersed in water or other liquid.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "To protect against risk of electrical shock, do not immerse base, motor, cord, or plug in water or other liquid."

2. "Turn the appliance OFF( ), then unplug from outlet when not in use, before putting on or taking off parts, and before cleaning. To unplug, grasp the plug and pull from the outlet. Never pull from the power cord."

3. "w WARNING Shock Hazard: This appliance has a polarized plug (one wide blade) that reduces the risk of electric shock. The plug fits only one way into a polarized outlet. Do not defeat the safety purpose of the plug by modifying the plug in any way or by using an adapter."

4. "w WARNING Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before cleaning. Do not immerse cord, plug, or base in any liquid."

5. "Wipe base, control knob, and cord with a damp cloth or sponge. If necessary, use a mild nonabrasive cleanser."

6. "All removable parts may also be cleaned in the sink with hot, soapy water. Use caution when washing chopping/mixing blade and slicing/shredding disc."

solution_steps.issue: Vegetables are not shredding or slicing as expected, which could be due to incorrect food size or quantity.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Check if the bowl and lid are locked in place as they may have moved slightly during processing. Refer to the "How to Use" sections.
2. Ensure that the processed food is not packed too much in the food chute or pushed too hard with the food pusher, as it may cause the food to be irregularly sliced or shredded. Refer to the Food Processing Charts for recommended sizes and quantities.
3. Verify that the disc attachments are reversible and labeled. The label should face up for the desired function. When using disc attachments, do not process past the MAX LEVEL on the bowl.
4. Make sure to use the Reversible Slicing/Shredding Disc with the desired cutting edge facing up, depending on whether you want to slice or shred.

4. Then press the On button to knead the dough. The blue LED On light will also be illuminated.
5. Press the Off button when finished.

solution_steps.issue: The food processor does not start because the work bowl and cover are not securely locked into position.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Place the food processor base on a dry, level countertop with the controls facing toward you. Do not plug the unit in until it is fully assembled.

2. With the large bowl on the base, use the handle to turn the work bowl counterclockwise to lock it onto the housing base.

3. Ensure the cover and feed tube are securely locked in place before operating the food processor.

solution_steps.issue: The food processor shuts off during operation.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "The cover may have become unlocked; check to make sure it is securely in position."

2. "A safety protector in the motor prevents the motor from overheating, which is caused by excessive strain. Press the Off control button and wait 10 to 15 minutes to allow the food processor to cool off before resuming."

3. "Make sure the bowl, lid and pushers are securely in place for the unit to operate."

solution_steps.issue: Nub of dough forms on top of blade and does not become uniformly kneaded.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Stop machine.
2. Carefully remove dough.
3. Divide it into 3 pieces.
4. Redistribute them evenly in the work bowl.

solution_steps.issue: Dough feels tough after kneading, requiring redistribution and further processing to become soft and pliable.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Divide dough into 2 or 3 pieces and redistribute evenly in bowl. 
2. Process 10 seconds or until uniformly soft and pliable.

solution_steps.issue: Food falls over in the feed tube because it is not packed full enough for optimal processing.
solution_steps.steps: 1. Large feed tube must be packed full for best results. If processing smaller quantities, use the small feed tube.

solution_steps.issue: Dough is too dry, requiring additional water to achieve the correct consistency.
solution_steps.steps: 1. While machine is running, add water, 1 tablespoon (15 ml) at a time until dough cleans the inside of the bowl.

solution_steps.issue: Dough is too wet, needing more flour to clean the inside of the bowl.
solution_steps.steps: 1. While machine is running, add flour, 1 tablespoon (15 ml) at a time until dough cleans the inside of the bowl.

solution_steps.issue: The food is unevenly processed due to unevenly cut ingredients or overloading the work bowl.
solution_steps.steps:
1. The ingredients should be cut evenly into ½- to 1-inch (1.25-2.5 cm) pieces before processing.
2. Process in batches to avoid overloading.

solution_steps.issue: Slices are uneven or slanted because food is not placed evenly in the feed tube or uneven pressure is applied on the pusher.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Place evenly cut food into the feed tube.
2. Apply even pressure on the pusher.

solution_steps.issue: Tumbler seal ring does not fit properly leading to leakage.
solution_steps.steps:

2. Make sure that the cutting edges of the blade do not come into contact with hard objects. This may cause the blade to get blunt.
3. Ensure that you never overfill the tumbler jar above the maximum level indication to avoid spillage.
4. Ensure that you never fill the tumbler jar with carbonated drinks to avoid damage of the tumbler.
5. Clean the other parts in water (< 60 °C) with some washing-up liquid or in a dishwasher.

solution_steps.issue: Mill attachment fails to connect securely to the motor unit.

If the problem persists, do not attempt to force the mill attachment into place and instead, ensure that all components are clean and free from obstruction, following the cleaning instructions: "Before you use the appliance and accessories for the first time, thoroughly clean the parts that come into contact with food."

solution_steps.issue: Food sticks to the wall of the blender jar and cannot be removed easily.

solution_steps.issue: Ingredients hotter than 80˚C cause damage to the blender jar.
solution_steps.steps:

2. Be careful if hot liquid is poured into the blender as it can be ejected out of the appliance due to a sudden steaming.
3. If you need to process hot liquids, ensure that the temperature of the liquids is below 80˚C before placing them in the blender jar.
4. To prevent spillage, do not put liquid more than the maximum capacity of the blender jar. When you process hot liquid or ingredients that tend to foam, do not put more than 1.8 liters in the blender jar.

solution_steps.issue: The appliance generates excessive noise, beyond the 83 dB(A) level.
solution_steps.steps:
1. "Never use any accessories or parts from other manufacturers or that Philips does not specifically recommend. If you use such accessories or parts, your guarantee becomes invalid." Ensure that you are only using original Philips accessories and parts with the appliance.
2. "Do not exceed the maximum capacity indication on the blender jar." Check that you have not exceeded the maximum capacity of the blender jar, as this could cause the appliance to work harder and generate more noise.
3. "Do not exceed the maximum quantities and processing times indicated in the relevant table." Confirm that you are not exceeding the recommended quantities and processing times for the ingredients you are using.
4. "Never fill the blender jar with ingredients hotter than 80˚C." Make sure the ingredients in the blender jar are not hotter than 80˚C, as this could affect the appliance's operation.
5. "Do not let the appliance run for more than 3 minutes at a time." Ensure that you are not running the appliance for longer than 3 minutes continuously, as this can lead to overheating and increased noise levels.
6. "Always make sure the lid is properly closed/assembled on the jar and the measuring cup is inserted properly in the lid before you switch on the appliance." Verify that the lid is properly closed and the measuring cup is inserted correctly, as improper assembly could lead to vibrations and noise.
7. "Do not use jar right after taking it out from dishwasher or refrigerator. Let it stay at room temperature for at least 5 min before use." If the jar was recently in the dishwasher or refrigerator, allow it to reach room temperature before use to prevent any noise issues related to temperature differences.

solution_steps.issue: The thermal cut-out resets inadvertently, interrupting operation.
solution_steps.steps:
1. Ensure that the appliance is not connected to an external switching device, such as a timer, or a circuit that is regularly switched on and off by the utility. According to the manual: "In order to avoid a hazard due to inadvertent resetting of the thermal cut-out, this appliance must not be supplied through an external switching device, such as a timer, or connected to a circuit that is regularly switched on and off by the utility."

2. Check if you are using any accessories or parts from other manufacturers or those not specifically recommended by Philips. The manual states: "Never use any accessories or parts from other manufacturers or that Philips does not specifically recommend. If you use such accessories or parts, your guarantee becomes invalid."

3. Make sure the blender jar is not filled with ingredients hotter than 80˚C, as this could potentially cause issues with the operation of the appliance, including the thermal cut-out. The manual advises: "Never fill the blender jar with ingredients hotter than 80˚C."

4. Verify that you have not exceeded the maximum capacity indication on the blender jar, as overfilling can affect the appliance's performance. The manual notes: "Do not exceed the maximum capacity indication on the blender jar."

5. Ensure that the processing times and quantities indicated in the relevant table are not exceeded. The manual cautions: "Do not exceed the maximum quantities and processing times indicated in the relevant table."

6. If food sticks to the wall of the blender jar, turn off the appliance and unplug it, then use a spatula to remove the food from the wall. The manual instructs: "If food sticks to the wall of the blender jar, switch off the appliance and unplug it. Then use a spatula to remove the food from the wall." 

7. Check that the appliance is not left idle for more than three minutes, which can cause it to go into standby mode. If it does, press the rotary knob to wake up the appliance. The manual explains: "Wake up the appliance: press the rotary knob to wake up the appliance when it is in standby mode. (The appliance goes to standby mode when it is idle for three minutes.)"
